betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Land on a planet and have no idea what you're breathing? The §6Atmosphere Analyzer§f scans the local atmosphere and tells you exactly what's in it: O2, N2, CO2 levels, breathability score (0-100), and toxicity warnings.

Requires a §6Planet ID Chip§f set to your destination. Place it inside a sealed room on the target planet and it reads the atmosphere in a 16-block radius. Output goes to an adjacent tank for use with the Atmosphere Terraformer.

Made in the Precision Assembler from a battery, Advanced Circuit, User Interface, lens, and tin plate. This block is the §6gateway§f to the Seal Detector, Biome Scanner, Navigation Beacon, Space Elevator, Orbital Laser Drill, and Railgun quest chains.

§ePS:§f Bring at least 32 Advanced Circuits and 64 tin plates. You'll want to place analyzers across different biomes for full coverage.
